svg.title: Performance reviews — SoftTrack web design mockup (#256)
svg.desc: A review is a conversation with a written record, and the record is usually a document that is hard to find a year later. HR opens a cycle with its questions and dates; the person reviews themselves, the manager reviews them, they meet and both sign off; and past reviews stay on the record and move with the person.
svg.text: · a conversation, with a record that can be found

g.text: a report’s Reviews tab, signed in as Amina, her manager
What are you proudest of this half?
The invoice list. It went from a wireframe to customers using it in six weeks, and it was the first thing I led.
What should Mei do more of?
Lead. The invoice list showed she can. Next half she owns statements end to end.
Sign in and see invoices, on production
12 people · self review by 25 Sep · manager’s by 9 Oct
the person, their manager chain, HR

svg.text: Past reviews stay on the record

g.text: They move with her when her manager changes. The new

svg.text: Done when HR can open a review cycle with a period, participants, questions and due dates; the steps are self review, manager’s review, meeting and sign-off, with optional peer
feedback; answers are drafts until submitted and then added to, not edited; each side sees the other’s only once it is submitted or shared; the person, their manager chain and HR
read a review; past reviews stay on the record; and HR sees who is late.

g.text: The manager does not see the self
review until it is submitted. The
person does not see the manager’s
A name, a period, who takes part, the questions, and the dates
No ratings scale by default, and nothing that computes a raise
